title: 故事改编与短剧分集
description: 把故事或小说整理成有因果、可拍摄的分集大纲，保留原作设定与悬念。

en.title: Story adaptation and episode outline
en.description: Adapt a story into shootable short-drama episodes while preserving its rules and suspense.

title: 单集可拍剧本
description: 从分集大纲写出场次、可见动作、对白与情绪变化。

en.title: Shootable episode screenplay
en.description: Write scenes, observable action and dialogue with clear emotional changes.

title: 角色设定与连戏锚点
description: 区分角色固定外貌、场次造型与逐镜变化，供三视图和视频复用。

en.title: Character bible and continuity anchors
en.description: Separate fixed identity, scene-specific looks and changing shot states for reusable references.

title: 剧本拆人物、场景与道具
description: 建立可复用的制作资产清单，记录使用场次和状态变化。

en.title: Cast, location and prop breakdown
en.description: Build a reusable asset inventory with scene usage, variants and state changes.

title: 剧本文本拆分镜
description: 把剧情拆成可独立出图、出视频的镜头，每镜明确起点与终点。

en.title: Screenplay to shot breakdown
en.description: Plan independently generatable shots with clear opening and ending states.

title: 双人戏站位与正反打
description: 先固定空间、轴线和视线，再设计主镜头与正反打覆盖。

en.title: Dialogue blocking and reverse coverage
en.description: Establish geography, axis and eyelines before planning master and reverse shots.

title: 对白改写与表演节拍
description: 用潜台词、停顿和可见动作改善短剧对白，不改变人物动机。

en.title: Dialogue and performance beats
en.description: Improve subtext, pauses and observable performance without changing motivations.

title: 分镜连戏与可生成性检查
description: 定位换装、道具、视线、空间、对白和镜头动作冲突。

en.title: Continuity and generation review
en.description: Locate identity, prop, eyeline, spatial, dialogue and motion conflicts.

title: 镜头交付与剪辑单
description: 整理真实片段、对白和补拍需求，供外部剪辑使用。

en.title: Shot delivery and edit handoff
en.description: Organize real clips, dialogue and pickup needs for an external edit.

title: 角色正面全身基准图
description: 先建立清楚的身份、体态与服装基准，再用于三视图和分镜。
prompt: 影视角色造型参考，{{角色编号与名称}}。{{年龄段、体态、脸型、辨识特征、发型发色}}，穿着{{服装层次、材质、颜色与鞋}}，整体美术方向为{{视觉风格}}。单人正面全身站立，身体自然放松，双手可见且不遮挡服装，头顶至鞋底完整入画，平视机位，透视克制。均匀柔光，简洁中性背景，清楚呈现面部、身体比例与服装结构。{{若有参考：保留参考图人物身份及指定造型}}。这是一张制作基准照，不表现剧情动作，不额外添加手持道具、文字标注、面板边框或水印。

en.title: Front full-body character anchor
en.description: Establish identity, proportions and costume before turnarounds or storyboard shots.
en.prompt: Film character reference for {{character ID and name}}. {{Age range, build, face, distinctive features and hair}}, wearing {{clothing layers, materials, colors and shoes}}, in {{art direction}}. One person standing front-facing in a relaxed neutral pose, hands visible without covering the costume. Show the entire figure from head to soles, with an eye-level camera and restrained perspective. Even soft light and a neutral background reveal identity, proportions and garment construction. {{If referenced: retain the supplied identity and designated costume}}. A production anchor rather than a dramatic scene; no extra handheld props, labels, panel borders or watermark.

title: 同一角色正侧背三视图
description: 用已选定的基准图生成同一人物的正面、侧面与背面。
prompt: 以提供的角色基准图为身份与造型依据，为{{角色名称}}制作一张横向三视图设定图。左到右依次为正面、严格 90 度侧面、背面；是同一个人在三个角度的完整全身展示。三个人像等高、同比例，头顶与脚底对齐，间距清楚，鞋和头发完整可见，手臂自然垂放不遮挡轮廓。保持参考中的五官、年龄感、身材、发型、发色、服装层次、材质、配色与鞋一致。简洁中性背景、均匀柔光、近似正交的制作视角。{{补充角色设计}}。不变成三位不同人物，不添加新服饰或道具，无文字、标题、边框、水印。

en.title: Consistent front, profile and back turnaround
en.description: Use an established anchor for the same person's three full-body views.
en.prompt: Use the supplied character anchor as the identity and costume source for {{character name}}. Create one horizontal turnaround sheet: front view, strict 90-degree profile and back view from left to right. These are three views of the same person, with equal scale, aligned head and foot baselines and clear separation. Show complete hair and shoes with relaxed arms. Retain identity, age, build, hair, garment layers, materials, colors and footwear. Neutral background, even soft lighting and near-orthographic production views. {{Additional established details}}. No different people, new costume or props, text, titles, borders or watermark.

title: 角色表情与表演参考
description: 保持人物身份，展示指定的表情和视线变化。
prompt: 根据提供的角色基准图，制作{{角色名称}}的表情参考图。{{需要的表情及排列，例如克制愤怒、迟疑、释然}}。每格使用相同头肩尺度、清楚间距、同一发型服装与面部身份；以眉眼、嘴角、下颌及视线变化表现情绪，符合{{写实或风格化表演方向}}。保持统一光源和中性背景，皮肤或材质符合既定美术。各表情自然可区分，不改变年龄、脸型和五官，不把不同表情画成不同角色，不加入剧情背景、对白气泡、文字标签和水印。

en.title: Character expression and performance reference
en.description: Explore expressions and eyelines while retaining the same identity.
en.prompt: Create an expression reference for {{character name}} using the supplied anchor. Show {{expressions and arrangement, such as restrained anger, hesitation and relief}}. Equal head-and-shoulder framing and clear spacing, preserving identity, hair and costume. Express emotion through brows, eyes, mouth, jaw and eyeline in {{realistic or stylized direction}}. Consistent lighting, neutral background and established material treatment. Distinct expressions without altered age or facial structure. No narrative setting, speech balloons, labels or watermark.

title: 影视场景空间基准图
description: 明确出入口、地标、陈设与光位，给后续镜头建立空间依据。
prompt: 为影视场景{{场景编号与名称}}制作无人空间参考图。时代和地点：{{设定}}；空间结构与固定陈设：{{门窗、出入口、桌椅及关键地标的相对位置}}；时间天气：{{设定}}；主光来源与方向：{{设定}}；美术风格和材质：{{方向}}。使用能清楚读懂空间的大全景，真实或既定风格的尺度，保留人物表演和走位区域。{{需固定的颜色与陈设细节}}。空间可实际连通，家具比例合理，地标位置明确。画面无人、无手、无人物剪影，不用夸张广角改变空间，不出现文字说明、分镜框和水印。

en.title: Location geography anchor
en.description: Establish entrances, landmarks, fixtures and light direction for later shots.
en.prompt: Unoccupied film location reference for {{location ID and name}}. Period and place: {{setting}}. Layout: {{relative positions of doors, windows, entrances, furniture and landmarks}}. Time and weather: {{conditions}}. Key-light source and direction: {{lighting}}. Style and materials: {{art direction}}. A readable wide view at the intended scale, with practical blocking areas. {{Established colors and fixture details}}. Physically connected routes and proportionate furniture. No people, hands, silhouettes, extreme wide-angle distortion, explanatory text, storyboard borders or watermark.

title: 同场景反向机位参考
description: 沿用空间基准图，补充侧向或反向覆盖，不重新设计房间。
prompt: 以提供的{{场景名称}}空间基准图为同一空间依据，生成{{目标机位的位置、朝向与景别}}的无人参考画面。保留原场景的门窗连接关系、陈设尺寸、材质、颜色和地标；摄影机从{{原机位}}移动到{{新机位}}，因此画面中的左右关系随观察方向合理改变。光源仍来自场景中同一扇窗或灯，不随机位自动翻转。{{新视角应看到的结构与边界}}。对原图不可见区域作符合平面关系的延伸，保留整体尺度和时间天气。无人、无手、无文字和水印，不把反打简单变成原图的水平镜像。

en.title: Reverse location coverage
en.description: Derive side or reverse coverage from established geography.
en.prompt: Use the supplied {{location name}} anchor as the same physical space. Generate an unoccupied view from {{target camera position, direction and framing}}. Retain door and window connectivity, fixture scale, materials, colors and landmarks. The camera moves from {{original position}} to {{new position}}, so screen-relative directions change consistently. Light still comes from the same physical window or lamp rather than flipping with the camera. {{Structures visible from this angle}}. Extend unseen areas plausibly from the layout, retaining scale, time and weather. No people, hands, text or watermark. Do not simply mirror the original horizontally.

title: 叙事道具与状态参考
description: 单独建立关键道具，明确材质、尺寸与当前状态。
prompt: 影视叙事道具参考：{{道具编号与名称}}。{{形状、材质、颜色、尺寸参照、可辨识细节}}。当前状态为{{合拢、打开、损坏等指定状态}}，美术方向为{{风格}}。在简洁中性背景下清楚展示完整轮廓与关键结构，使用均匀照明和可信的接触阴影。{{若需多视角，指定各视角及一致状态}}。沿用已有参考的设计，不添加故事里没有的功能、饰品或品牌。画面无人、无手持展示、无包装文案与水印；可见的叙事文字仅限{{必要文字原文或无}}。

en.title: Narrative prop and state reference
en.description: Define a key prop's material, scale and state independently.
en.prompt: Film narrative-prop reference for {{prop ID and name}}. {{Shape, material, color, scale and distinguishing details}}. State: {{closed, open, damaged or specified state}}. Art direction: {{style}}. Show the complete silhouette and construction on a neutral background with even light and contact shadows. {{Views and consistent state if needed}}. Retain the established design; no unsupported functions, decorations or branding. No person, holding hand, packaging copy or watermark. Visible story text is limited to {{exact text or none}}.

title: 单镜首帧分镜图片
description: 将文本镜头和人物、场景参考组合成可用于图生视频的干净首帧。
prompt: 生成影视镜头{{镜号}}的单张开场画面，视觉风格{{风格}}。人物身份与服装依据{{人物参考图及各自用途}}；空间结构与光源依据{{场景参考图}}；关键道具依据{{道具参考图或描述}}。{{景别、机位高度、观察方向、前中后景构图}}。在这个瞬间，{{每个人物的画面位置、朝向、姿态、双手、持物、视线及表情}}。{{环境、时间、光源方向与可辨识地标}}。保留参考角色身份和本场造型，表达{{本镜的核心叙事信息}}。只展示动作开始前的一个明确瞬间，不将后续动作画成残影或连续格；无字幕、镜号、分镜边框、运镜箭头和水印。

en.title: Single-shot opening storyboard frame
en.description: Combine a shot and design references into a clean image-to-video opening.
en.prompt: Create the single opening frame for film shot {{shot ID}} in {{art direction}}. Identity and costume follow {{character images and roles}}; layout and light follow {{location reference}}; props follow {{prop references or descriptions}}. {{Framing, camera height, direction and foreground/midground/background}}. At this instant, {{each person's screen position, facing, pose, hands, objects, eyeline and expression}}. {{Setting, time, light source and landmarks}}. Retain identities and scene-specific looks while conveying {{essential information}}. One definite moment before the next action, without motion trails or sequential panels. No subtitles, shot numbers, borders, arrows or watermark.

title: 多镜分镜联系表
description: 将镜头排成审稿图；独立生成用的首帧仍应逐镜制作。
prompt: 制作一张用于人工审稿的影视分镜联系表，采用{{行列布局}}，按从左到右、从上到下排列以下镜头：{{每格镜号、景别、机位、人物站位和关键瞬间}}。整体风格为{{黑白线稿或指定风格}}，角色与场景依据{{参考图用途}}，所有面板保持统一画幅、清楚间距和一致的角色服装、道具、地标与光位。每格只画该镜的一个关键瞬间，不在一个面板内混入多个镜头。除用户明确要求的{{简短镜号或无}}外无文字。这是分镜审稿联系表，不是已拆成独立资产的首帧集合，不出现水印。

en.title: Storyboard contact sheet
en.description: Preview shots together; generate independent clean frames separately when needed.
en.prompt: Create a storyboard contact sheet for human review in {{row and column layout}}. Arrange shots left to right and top to bottom: {{shot IDs, framing, viewpoint, blocking and key moment per panel}}. Use {{sketch or specified style}}, following {{reference roles}}. Consistent panel ratios, clear gutters, identities, costume, props, landmarks and lighting. Each panel contains one key moment from its assigned shot. No text except {{requested shot IDs or none}}. This is a review sheet, not already separated first-frame assets. No watermark.

title: 单镜动作与情绪表演
description: 用起始状态、动作因果和可见反应表达戏剧变化。
prompt: {{视觉风格}}。{{场景、时间、天气及主光来源}}。{{景别与机位}}中，{{角色外貌、服装、起始位置、姿态、双手持物与视线}}。先{{起始动作}}，随后{{由此引发的可见变化或接触结果}}，角色以{{眼神、呼吸、嘴角或重心变化}}作出反应，最后停在{{明确结束姿态与道具位置}}。摄影机{{一个主要运镜及速度幅度，或固定}}，将注意力从{{起始信息}}引向{{揭示信息}}。环境声为{{可听见的具体声源}}，{{音乐需求或无配乐}}。保持同一角色造型、空间地标和物理光源，动作有重量和接触反馈，不添加未要求的字幕或镜头切换。

en.title: Single-shot action and emotional performance
en.description: Convey dramatic change through an opening state, causal action and visible reaction.
en.prompt: {{Visual style}}. {{Location, time, weather and light source}}. In a {{framing and camera position}}, {{identity, costume, starting pose, hands, objects and eyeline}}. First {{initial action}}, then {{observable change or contact consequence}}. The character reacts through {{eyes, breath, mouth or weight shift}}, ending in {{final pose and prop position}}. The camera {{one principal move with speed and amplitude, or holds still}}, directing attention from {{initial information}} toward {{reveal}}. Sound: {{audible sources}}. {{Music or no score}}. Retain identity, landmarks and physical light with credible weight and contact. No unsolicited subtitles or cuts.

title: 对白镜头与听者反应
description: 明确说话人、台词和听者动作，供支持音画生成的模型使用。
prompt: {{视觉风格}}，{{场景和光源}}，{{景别及机位}}。{{说话人身份、服装、站位与朝向}}面对{{听者位置}}，先{{说话前的表演动作}}，用{{语言、音色、语速、情绪}}说：“{{台词原文}}”。说话人的嘴部清楚可见，身体动作配合语义；听者{{视线、闭嘴倾听及反应动作}}。说完后，{{停顿和结束状态}}。摄影机{{固定或主要运镜}}。保留{{空间、道具与光位连续性}}。环境声{{具体声源}}，{{配乐需求或无配乐}}。台词只在说话动作处出现一次，不把旁白变成其他人物开口，不添加字幕或额外台词。

en.title: Dialogue shot and listener reaction
en.description: Bind a line to its speaker and listener for audiovisual-capable models.
en.prompt: {{Style}}, {{location and light}}, {{framing and viewpoint}}. {{Speaker identity, costume, position and facing}} looks toward {{listener}}, first {{pre-speech action}}, then says in {{language, timbre, pace and emotion}}, “{{exact dialogue}}”. The mouth is clearly visible and gestures support the line. The listener {{eyeline, closed-mouth listening and reaction}}. After the line, {{pause and final state}}. The camera {{holds or makes one move}}. Preserve {{spatial, prop and light continuity}}. Ambient sound: {{source}}. {{Music or no score}}. The line appears once, attached to the speaker's action. Do not turn voiceover into another person's speech or add subtitles or dialogue.

title: 分镜首帧转动态镜头
description: 从已选首帧继续动作，保留人物、构图与空间关系。
prompt: 以输入图片作为视频开场的实际画面，沿用其中的角色身份、服装、物件、空间关系、画幅与光线。开场时{{简述首帧中可见状态}}。随后{{一个清晰的主要动作及必要中间过程}}，{{环境或对手的可见反应}}，最终{{结束姿态、视线和持物位置}}。摄影机{{与首帧兼容的固定或主要运动}}。{{对白原文与说话动作；无则省略}}。声音{{环境和动作声；只用于支持音画生成的模型}}。{{需要保留的连续性细节}}。运动从现有状态自然发生，不另起一张不同构图的开场，不将人物换装或替换，不增加分镜边框和文字。

en.title: Storyboard first frame to moving shot
en.description: Continue from a real image while retaining identity, composition and geography.
en.prompt: Use the input image as the actual opening frame, retaining identity, costume, objects, spatial relationships, aspect ratio and lighting. Initially {{visible state}}. Then {{principal action and intermediate movement}}, followed by {{visible reaction}}, ending in {{pose, eyeline and prop position}}. The camera {{holds or makes a compatible move}}. {{Exact dialogue attached to speaking action, or omit}}. Sound: {{ambience and action sounds for an audiovisual-capable model}}. {{Continuity details}}. Motion develops from the supplied state rather than a different opening composition. No costume or identity replacement, storyboard borders or added text.

title: 首尾帧之间的连续动作
description: 描述两个状态之间的运动路径，适用于支持首尾帧的模型。
prompt: 以首帧图片作为开场，以尾帧图片作为结束状态，在一个连续镜头里连接两者。首帧中{{起始姿态、道具状态、人物与摄影机位置}}；尾帧中{{目标姿态、道具状态、人物与摄影机位置}}。过程依次为{{关键动作、接触、重心与物件变化}}，摄影机{{能连接两个构图的运动或固定机位}}。运动逐渐收敛到尾帧的站位、朝向、视线和构图，不用突然瞬移、物件凭空替换或中途硬切跳过变化。沿用人物身份、服装、场景地标与同一物理光源。{{声音与对白需求或无}}。首尾差异过大时应先修改设计或拆镜，不以提示词保证不可能的连续变化。

en.title: Continuous motion between first and last frames
en.description: Describe a plausible path between two states for a keyframe-capable model.
en.prompt: Begin at the first frame and end at the last frame in one continuous shot. Opening: {{pose, prop state, subject and camera positions}}. Ending: {{target pose, prop state, subject and camera positions}}. Connect them through {{ordered actions, contact, weight shifts and object changes}} as the camera {{moves compatibly or stays fixed}}. Converge to the final blocking, orientation, eyeline and composition. Do not bypass changes with teleportation, unexplained replacement or a hard cut. Retain identity, costume, landmarks and physical light. {{Sound and dialogue or none}}. If the states cannot connect plausibly, revise or split the shot rather than promise impossible continuity.

title: MiniMax H3 文生音画镜头
description: H3 基础音画描述模板；关键帧任务需另绑定真实首尾帧。

en.title: MiniMax H3 text-to-audiovisual shot
en.description: A base H3 audiovisual template; keyframe work also needs actual frame bindings.

title: MiniMax H3 多参考音画镜头
description: 用六段描述明确人物、画面、视频与声音各自参考什么。
prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is {{角色的固定外貌与本场服装，英文}} from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is {{场景结构与关键地标，英文}} from <Picture 2>.
{{仅在真实绑定时补充其他 Picture、Video、Audio 标签及用途，按各类型实际输入顺序编号}}

summary:
[reference generation] {{用英文概述目标动作与参考关系}}.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - {{要保留的身份与造型}}.
<Subject 2>: fully_preserved - {{要保留的空间、材质与光位}}.
{{只列实际引用内容的保留、变化或声音参考关系}}

detailed_description:
{{用英文说明整体影像方向}}. [Shot 1] {{景别、角色的画面位置与初始状态}}. {{具体动作过程、运镜、接触反馈、结束状态，在实际生效处引用对应标签}}. {{若有对白：<Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 台词原文</d>，台词只出现一次}}.

overall_soundscape:
{{用英文描述环境与动作声；有参考音频时说明参考声线还是复用音轨，不重复台词}}.

non_diegetic_music:
{{用英文说明配乐或 N/A}}

en.title: MiniMax H3 multi-reference audiovisual shot
en.description: Use six sections to distinguish subject, image, video and audio reference roles.
en.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is {{fixed appearance and scene costume}} from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is {{location layout and landmarks}} from <Picture 2>.
{{Add other Picture, Video and Audio labels only for actual bound inputs; number each media type in input order and state its role}}

summary:
[reference generation] {{Target action and reference relationships}}.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - {{Identity and costume}}.
<Subject 2>: fully_preserved - {{Geography, materials and light}}.
{{Only real preservation, change and audio relationships}}

detailed_description:
{{Visual direction}}. [Shot 1] {{Framing, positions and starting state}}. {{Actions, camera, consequences and ending state; cite reference labels where they apply}}. {{If needed: <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[English] Exact dialogue</d>; each line appears once}}.

overall_soundscape:
{{Ambience and physical sound; distinguish timbre reference from signal reuse, without repeated dialogue}}.

non_diegetic_music:
{{Audience-only music or N/A}}
